question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. C sits second to the right of D. A is an immediate neighbour of C. Only two people sit between F and A. B sits to the immediate right of F. Who sits third to the left of E?
solution:
**People **: A, B, C, D, E, F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. C sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42e6b7caed21d19a6ab71b62f962503bcc21944a521ee41d50f38f85dcebf4bd.png] 

2. A is an immediate neighbour of C.There are two cases of this statement.

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c53f2e00b41c5ee054cbdabb3c239029f2bdd296524a6d9437cb6d908ea4eb0.png] 

Case 2 :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7548bf607bb86a14fc535bd8476a1470c6e8b75afee4865c07d34b1d9aad4bc4.png] 

3. Only two people sit between F and A. Therefore, Case 2 is eliminated .

Case 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16e4e0f2577d06c219c1fa7b6dc4c3652a66214e9d564254e6323b785217629c.png] 

4. B sits to the immediate right of F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/916e6cdf6593a28437845497ea6ae540ccb11986aac44ebb9aa06b546fe6e84f.png] 

**Possible seating arrangement : **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b6873015a8fb68a3c177d61413048498ff1b66cc487992b46a66119e420fa3a.png] 

Therefore,** **__**D**__** **sits third to the left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"D"**.
